keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: Product keywords to expand, e.g. yoga mat, dog bed, phone case.

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces
marketplaces.description: Country codes: us, uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, jp, mx, au, br, nl, ae, sa, se, pl, tr, sg, be, eg, in. Each seed is expanded on every marketplace listed.

department.title: Department (search alias)
department.description: Amazon search alias. aps = All Departments. Others: stripbooks, electronics, beauty, fashion, garden, toys-and-games, sporting, pets, grocery, hpc, tools, automotive, baby-products, kitchen.

expandLetters.title: Expand with a to z
expandLetters.description: Query "seed a" ... "seed z". The main source of long-tail terms (26 requests per seed).

expandDigits.title: Expand with 0 to 9
expandDigits.description: Query the seed followed by each digit. Good for sizes, models and pack counts.

expandPrefixes.title: Expand with intent prefixes
expandPrefixes.description: Query best, cheap, top, small, large, kids, women, men... in front of the seed.

expandSuffixes.title: Expand with suffixes
expandSuffixes.description: Query the seed followed by for, with, without, vs, set, pack, kit, accessories, replacement, gift.

maxRowsPerKeyword.title: Max keywords per seed
maxRowsPerKeyword.description: Cap on unique keywords per seed per marketplace.

maxRows.title: Max keywords per run
maxRows.description: Cap on total keyword rows. Controls cost.
